gaps.sentence: He's always been fascinated by ___ universe.
___ disabled are offered free entry on Sundays.
gaps.explanation: 'The disabled' = disabled people as a group.

gaps.sentence: She was appointed ___ managing director at just thirty-four.
gaps.explanation: After 'appoint/elect/name + unique role' no article is used.

gaps.sentence: He was born in ___ Netherlands, not in Belgium.
gaps.explanation: Country names that are plural or contain 'Kingdom/Republic/States' take 'the': the Netherlands.

gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: He left ___ school at sixteen and went straight into a job.
gaps.explanation: Leave school (finish education) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ eight o'clock news — hurry up!
gaps.explanation: 'The eight o'clock news' — a specific, known programme.
'Have an eye for something' — fixed idiom with 'an'.
